drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy with MCC

timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. 77-year-old male admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.68, bnp 83, creatinine 0.91, hemoglobin 14.6, platelets 319, sodium 140, wbc 6.8; vitals dbp 75-79, heart_rate 83-87, map 92-97, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 17-18, sbp 125-132, spo2 96-98, temp 37-37.2
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity; Transthoracic echo: LVEF 60%, normal
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Hypertension. Acute systolic heart failure.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.9, hemoglobin 14.7, platelets 321, sodium 140, wbc 6.4; vitals dbp 76-79, heart_rate 82-86, map 94-96, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-17, sbp 126-132, spo2 96-98, temp 37.1-37.2
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Hypertension. Acute systolic heart failure. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 77-year-old male, length of stay 3 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Hypertension. Acute systolic heart failure. Follow up with primary care in one week. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed.
